name: Aaron Marketing Skills

Eight typed advisory frameworks (TALE, CORE-EEAT, CITE, STAR, ECHO, SEND, ROAS, RAMP) use machine-checkable auditor artifacts and immutable standalone runtime contracts. Keyless-first and zero-dependency.
